entries.name: Vitriol Veins
entries.lore: Distilled volatile acid replaces your vital humors. Your strikes shatter stone with ferocious power, though your brittle shell can endure little punishment.

entries.name: Cloven Sinew
entries.lore: Grafted tendon from a swift sacrificial beast, woven into the vessel's stride to grant tireless speed across the arena.

entries.name: Slag Carapace
entries.lore: Cooled furnace dross fused directly to the ribs, encasing the vessel's vital core in a hardened protective shell.

entries.name: Spasmodic Nerve
entries.lore: Refined quicksilver infused along the spinal conduit, sharpening synaptic reflexes so your arts can be invoked in rapid succession.

entries.name: Bellows Heart
entries.lore: Alchemical bellows fitted to the core, stoking the inner flame to fuel destructive potency and amplify critical detonations.

entries.name: Waxen Pinions
entries.lore: Feathers bound in consecrated tallow that lighten the vessel's frame and quicken its steps across the ash.

entries.name: Parasitic Alembic
entries.lore: A living glass vessel engorged on distilled vitae. Channels rapid, furious distillation into your arts, but swells your frame into an easier target.

entries.name: Lead Plumbum
entries.lore: A dense sphere of alchemical lead settled in the vessel, firmly anchoring the animating humors against collapse.

entries.name: Quicksilver Draught
entries.lore: Purified liquid argent thins the humors, allowing aether to circulate freely and renewing your casts with swift grace.

entries.name: Astrologer's Ocular
entries.lore: A heavy brass ocular bolted to the brow. Reveals fatal celestial alignments and structural fractures, drastically sharpening critical strikes at the heavy cost of your stride.

entries.name: Salt Effigy
entries.lore: Desiccates the vessel's silhouette into a compact, elusive form that slips cleanly between striking claws and projectiles.

entries.name: Pale Moon Covenant
entries.lore: An unforgiven heresy against the Great Work. Ignites your arts with devastating pale lunar fire and catastrophic critical blasts, demanding a terrible toll upon your corporeal vessel.

entries.name: Cinnabar Leech
entries.lore: A vermilion leech sealed in amber glass. It drinks the lingering humors from slain enemies and siphons their vital essence into your vessel.
